<thought>Using the monoisotopic peak at m/z 100.0524 and the isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 5.6 % and M+2 ≈ 0.5 %), the formula that matches the exact mass is C₅H₈O₂. This accounts for the observed 13C contribution to the M+1 peak and gives the correct exact mass.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H8O2</final_answer>
